text: Seeking endorsement of events for Municipal Significance for liquor licensing purposes.

North York Community Council: 1. Under its delegated authority under Chapter 27-152, Delegation to Community Councils, declared the following to be events of municipal significance, for liquor licensing purposes: a. the "Foodalicious Food Festival" event to be held on June 9, 2018 from 11:00 a.m. to 11:59 p.m. and on June 10, 2018 from 11:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. at 35 Carl Hall Road, Downsview Park, at the outside event field; and b. the "Downsview Ribfest" event to be held on August 31, September 1 and 2, 2018 from 11:00 a.m. to 11:59 p.m. and on September 3, 2018 from 11:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. at 35 Carl Hall Road, Downsview Park, at the outside event field.
